idea-plugin.name: Crypto Export Notice Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Ten checks on the export paragraph of a repository that ships encryption

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Crypto Export Notice Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 10 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/crypto-export-notice-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/crypto-export-notice-lint

action.text: Crypto Export Notice Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Crypto Export Notice Lint on the file in the editor
